webhook.rule: Never mutate revenue in DreamLedger. CUBE webhook stops at evidence plus HUMAN_QUEUE/PENDING.

truth_rules: PAYMENT_RECEIVED is evidence, not revenue recognition.
Only REVENUE_RECOGNIZED with livemode=true contributes to live verified revenue.
Human approval remains mandatory before revenue mutation.
CUBE_COMMERCE_URL must point to a deployed CUBE service before production checkout is enabled.
CUBE_PROXY_TOKEN must never be committed to git.

storage_gate.reason: CUBE currently defaults to a Windows D: artifact root, which is not a durable production storage boundary.
accepted_backends: durable cloud object/database store with append/idempotency guarantees

rollback.effect: CUBE proxy routes return 503 and legacy DreamLedger commerce remains available.
